description: Deploy API service with password exposed in debug msg — T5 deny

playbook.content:
- name: Deploy API service
  hosts: api_servers
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: 'Deploying with password {{ db_password }}'
    - ansible.builtin.service:
        name: myapp
        state: restarted

tier_rationale: debug msg exposes db_password on production
common_mistakes: ansible-lint: no rule for debug msg content
